scenes.caption: Photo 1875
scenes.text: The Terreiro de Jesus, just north of Praça Municipal, is home to structures from the 17th to 19th century constructions.

scenes.caption: Photo 1880
scenes.text: Many buildings of the Historic Center have been renovated since the initial survey of Salvador by the National Institute of Historic and Artistic Heritage in the 1930s.

scenes.caption: Photo 1905
scenes.text: The Church of the Holy See (Igreja da Sé), an integral part of the architectural set of the Historic Center, was demolished in 1933 along with four other blocks of buildings from the colonial and imperial periods.

scenes.caption: Photo 1920
scenes.text: The Historic Center of Salvador as a whole was listed as a national heritage site by the National Institute of Historic and Artistic Heritage in 1984.
